motivation: DEV diagnostics indicate v3-v5 probability compression is primarily generated by the market recalibration architecture. Replace absolute-probability rebuilding with a residual correction that preserves the direct market distribution when correction strength is zero.

residual_definition_policy.residual_model_inputs: strictly pre-race leakage-safe non-market features only
residual_definition_policy.center_rule_draft: subtract market-probability-weighted residual mean within race

uncertainty_adaptation.rule: alpha_eff_race may shrink toward zero as preregistered pre-race market uncertainty rises

hard_invariants: alpha_eff_race = 0 implies p_candidate exactly equals p_market
constant residual across all horses implies p_candidate exactly equals p_market after centering
probabilities remain positive and sum to one within each race
no result/final-payout/final-odds fields may enter residual model
